title: Run Lint All (Full Report)
summary: Runs the whole rule catalog against a project's indexed code and reports every surviving finding -- the overall project health check
intro: Read this when you want an overall health check of a project: it runs the whole rule catalog over the indexed code and reports every surviving finding, optionally limited to one project with --project.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Code Quality > Run Lint All (Full Report)...

flags.name: --quiet
flags.summary: suppress per-file progress lines written to stderr

pitfalls: lint `<file>` is a strict SUBSET: project-wide rules can only fire in lint-all.
